doc: Open container with a closed floor, one flat bar handle reaching far beyond the body, marker balls. Body = thin-wall lathe ('polar' profile: wall thickness measured where inner and outer faces were both seen, closed floor = observed inner floor + t). Handle = the largest residual cluster that reaches beyond the body by more than k*s, fitted as a straight bar in its own plane whose inner end sits inside the body wall. Balls = compact residual clusters on the body or handle. Reproduces hand kit A (prim_potlid.build_pot, variant fit) with the default windows.
